```
    · rwa [codecInputRead_wire M n s x hx c _ hip] at hin
    · funext i
      simpa only [codecRowOf, MultiTapeTM.ConfigCount.coreCode,
        Cfg.workTapeSymbols, hp i] using hws i
  · rintro ⟨hst, hip, hwp, hin, hws⟩
    refine ⟨hst, hip, fun i => (hh i).mpr (hwp i), ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [codecInputRead_wire M n s x hx c _ hip] using hin
    · intro i
      simpa only [codecRowOf, MultiTapeTM.ConfigCount.coreCode,
        Cfg.workTapeSymbols, hwp i] using congrFun hws i

/-- One output bit of the selected action: copy unmarked cells, write at old
heads, shift markers, rewrite the state, and update the output summary. -/
private def codecExpected (M : FinTM Bool) (n s : ℕ) (p : CodecPositions M n s)
    (act : Action M.k Bool M.State) (a : CodecPort M → Bool) : CodecBit M n s → Bool
  | .input _ => a .oldBit
  | .inputHead j => decide (moveInputPos p.1 act.inputTape = j)
  | .state st => decide (act.state = st)
  | .work i j b =>
      if b.val = 0 ∨ b.val = 1 then
        if p.2 i = j then
          match (act.workTapes i).1 with
          | none => a .oldBit
          | some v => decide (v = some (decide (b.val = 1)))
        else a .oldBit
      else decide (((p.2 i).val : ℤ) - s + ((act.workTapes i).2 : ℤ) = (j.val : ℤ) - s)
  | .summary dead => decide
      (outSummary (codecSummaryWord (codecReadSummary (a (.summary false)) (a (.summary true))) ++
        act.output.toList) = if dead then .dead else .accept)

/-- The guarded single-bit predicate compiled by per-gate Boolean universality. -/
private noncomputable def codecGate (M : FinTM Bool) (n s : ℕ) (p : CodecPositions M n s)
    (q : CodecCase M) (b : CodecBit M n s) (a : CodecPort M → Bool) : Bool := by
  classical
  exact decide (codecGuard M n s p q a → a .newBit = codecExpected M n s p (codecAction M q) a b)

/-- Each expected bit is the exact bit of the action applied to the canonical
output representative; only the guard's positions and a constant number of bits enter.

**Proof sketch.** Input content is unchanged, state and input-head markers follow
the action, and the two work-symbol flags copy except at a written head cell.
The integer head equation retains an exterior move rather than clamping it.
The summary ports supply the canonical output word for the append table. -/
private theorem codecExpected_apply (M : FinTM Bool) (n s : ℕ) (x : List Bool)
    (hx : x.length = n) (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (t : CodecRow M n s)
    (p : CodecPositions M n s) (q : CodecCase M) (act : Action M.k Bool M.State)
    (hp : (codecRowOf M n s x hx c).inputHead = p.1)
    (hh : ∀ i, c.workTapePos i = ((p.2 i).val : ℤ) - s) (b : CodecBit M n s) :
    codecExpected M n s p act
      (codecPairBits (codecRowOf M n s x hx c) t ∘ codecGateWire M n s p q b) b =
    codecObserve M n s x hx
      (act.apply { c with output := codecSummaryWord (outSummary c.output) }) b := by
  cases b with
  | input i => rfl
  | inputHead j =>
    subst n
    have hpos : c.inputPos = p.1 := hp
    change decide (moveInputPos p.1 act.inputTape = j) =
      decide (moveInputPos c.inputPos act.inputTape = j)
    rw [hpos]
  | state st => rfl
  | summary d =>
    simp [codecExpected, codecObserve, codecGateWire, codecPairBits, codecRowBits,
      codecRowOf, Action.apply, codecReadSummary_flags]
  | work i j b =>
    have hcell : ((j.val : ℤ) - s = c.workTapePos i) ↔ p.2 i = j := by
      rw [hh i]
      constructor
      · intro h
        apply Fin.ext
        omega
      · rintro h
        rw [h]
    fin_cases b <;>
      simp only [codecExpected, codecObserve, Function.comp_apply, codecGateWire,
        codecPairBits, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, codecRowBits, codecRowOf,
        MultiTapeTM.ConfigCount.coreCode, Action.apply]
    · rcases Option.eq_none_or_eq_some ((act.workTapes i).1) with hw | ⟨v, hw⟩ <;>
        by_cases hj : p.2 i = j <;>
        simp [hw, hj, Function.update, hcell]
    · rcases Option.eq_none_or_eq_some ((act.workTapes i).1) with hw | ⟨v, hw⟩ <;>
        by_cases hj : p.2 i = j <;>
        simp [hw, hj, Function.update, hcell]
    · simp [hh i]

/-- A true transition guard makes its expected bit the actual successor bit.
Output normalization is justified by `NDTM.coreSum_stepWith`. -/
private theorem codecExpected_step (M : FinTM Bool) (n s : ℕ) (x : List Bool)
    (hx : x.length = n) (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (hc : c.InWindow s)
    (t : CodecRow M n s) (p : CodecPositions M n s) (q : CodecCase M) (b : CodecBit M n s)
    (h : codecGuard M n s p q
      (codecPairBits (codecRowOf M n s x hx c) t ∘ codecGateWire M n s p q b)) :
    codecExpected M n s p (codecAction M q)
      (codecPairBits (codecRowOf M n s x hx c) t ∘ codecGateWire M n s p q b) b =
      codecObserve M n s x hx (M.tm.step c) b := by
  obtain ⟨hst, hip, hwp, hin, hws⟩ := (codecGuard_spec M n s x hx c hc t p q b).mp h
  have he : (c.state, c.inputSymbol, c.workTapeSymbols) = q :=
    Prod.ext hst (Prod.ext hin hws)
  have ha : (codecAction M q).apply { c with output := codecSummaryWord (outSummary c.output) } =
      M.tm.step { c with output := codecSummaryWord (outSummary c.output) } := by
    rw [← he]
    exact codecAction_apply M x { c with output := codecSummaryWord (outSummary c.output) }
  calc
    _ = codecObserve M n s x hx
        ((codecAction M q).apply { c with output := codecSummaryWord (outSummary c.output) }) b :=
      codecExpected_apply M n s x hx c t p q _ hip hwp b
    _ = codecObserve M n s x hx
        (M.tm.step { c with output := codecSummaryWord (outSummary c.output) }) b := by rw [ha]
    _ = _ := congrFun (codecObserve_step_normalize M n s x hx c).symm b

/-- Compile one finite-port gate, retaining a machine-only cost bound. -/
private theorem codecGate_cnf (M : FinTM Bool) (n s : ℕ) (p : CodecPositions M n s)
    (q : CodecCase M) (b : CodecBit M n s) :
    ∃ φ : CNF (Bool × CodecBit M n s),
      codecCnfCost φ ≤ 2 ^ (3 * M.k + 7) * (3 * M.k + 8) ∧
      ∀ a, φ.eval a = codecGate M n s p q b (a ∘ codecGateWire M n s p q b) := by
  letI : Inhabited (Bool × CodecBit M n s) := ⟨(false, .summary false)⟩
  let e := Fintype.equivFin (CodecPort M)
  obtain ⟨φ, hcost, heval⟩ := codecLocalCheck (Fintype.card (CodecPort M))
    (fun i => codecGateWire M n s p q b (e.symm i))
    (fun a => codecGate M n s p q b (fun port => a (e port)))
  refine ⟨φ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [codecPort_card, Nat.add_assoc] using hcost
  · intro a
    simpa only [e.symm_apply_apply, Function.comp_def] using heval a

/-- Choose the per-gate CNF from the proved constant-arity universality bound. -/
private noncomputable def codecGateCNF (M : FinTM Bool) (n s : ℕ)
    (p : CodecPositions M n s) (q : CodecCase M) (b : CodecBit M n s) :
    CNF (Bool × CodecBit M n s) := (codecGate_cnf M n s p q b).choose

/-- The chosen gate formula has exactly its local semantics and machine-only cost. -/
private theorem codecGateCNF_spec (M : FinTM Bool) (n s : ℕ)
    (p : CodecPositions M n s) (q : CodecCase M) (b : CodecBit M n s) :
    codecCnfCost (codecGateCNF M n s p q b) ≤ 2 ^ (3 * M.k + 7) * (3 * M.k + 8) ∧
    ∀ a, (codecGateCNF M n s p q b).eval a =
      codecGate M n s p q b (a ∘ codecGateWire M n s p q b) :=
  (codecGate_cnf M n s p q b).choose_spec

/-- Enumerate the guarded positions, finite table cases, and updated coordinates. -/
private abbrev CodecGateIndex (M : FinTM Bool) (n s : ℕ) :=
  CodecPositions M n s × CodecCase M × CodecBit M n s

/-- Conjoin one constant-arity gate for each guarded coordinate update. -/
private noncomputable def codecTransitionCNF (M : FinTM Bool) (n s : ℕ) :
    CNF (Bool × CodecBit M n s) :=
  (Finset.univ.toList : List (CodecGateIndex M n s)).flatMap fun ix =>
    codecGateCNF M n s ix.1 ix.2.1 ix.2.2

/-- The transition conjunction enforces exactly all of its local update gates. -/
private theorem codecTransitionCNF_eval (M : FinTM Bool) (n s : ℕ)
    (a : Bool × CodecBit M n s → Bool) :
    (codecTransitionCNF M n s).eval a = true ↔
      ∀ p q b, codecGate M n s p q b (a ∘ codecGateWire M n s p q b) = true := by
  have hg := fun p q b => (codecGateCNF_spec M n s p q b).2 a
  simp only [codecTransitionCNF, codecCnf_eval_flatMap, Finset.mem_toList,
    Finset.mem_univ, forall_const, CodecGateIndex, Prod.forall, hg]

/-- The local conjunction is equivalent to adjacency on windowed same-input pairs.

**Proof sketch.** For soundness, choose the actual head tuple and scanned-symbol
case. Its guard is true, so every target bit equals the exact successor bit;
the exact-marker lemma identifies the successor vertex. For completeness,
every true guard reads the same native transition, whose bits match the target.
This includes the silent halted identity action and exterior-head rejection. -/
private theorem codecTransitionCNF_step_iff (M : FinTM Bool) (n s : ℕ) (x : List Bool)
    (hx : x.length = n) (c d : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x)
    (hc : c.InWindow s) (hd : d.InWindow s) :
    (codecTransitionCNF M n s).eval
      (codecPairBits (codecRowOf M n s x hx c) (codecRowOf M n s x hx d)) = true ↔
      NDTM.coreSum (M.tm.step c) = NDTM.coreSum d := by
  rw [codecTransitionCNF_eval, ← codecObserve_step_iff M n s x hx c d hc hd]
  constructor
  · intro h
    let p : CodecPositions M n s :=
      ((codecRowOf M n s x hx c).inputHead, (codecRowOf M n s x hx c).heads)
    let q : CodecCase M := (c.state, c.inputSymbol, c.workTapeSymbols)
    funext b
    have hg : codecGuard M n s p q
        (codecPairBits (codecRowOf M n s x hx c) (codecRowOf M n s x hx d) ∘
          codecGateWire M n s p q b) := by
      apply (codecGuard_spec M n s x hx c hc _ p q b).mpr
      refine ⟨rfl, rfl, ?_, rfl, rfl⟩
      intro i
      exact (codec_posCode_eq_iff s _ (hc.1 i) _).mp rfl
    have hb := h p q b
    simp only [codecGate, decide_eq_true_eq] at hb
    have he := hb hg
    change codecRowBits (codecRowOf M n s x hx d) b = _ at he
    exact (codecExpected_step M n s x hx c hc _ p q b hg).symm.trans he.symm
  · intro h p q b
    simp only [codecGate, decide_eq_true_eq]
    intro hg
    change codecRowBits (codecRowOf M n s x hx d) b = _
    rw [codecExpected_step M n s x hx c hc _ p q b hg, h]

/-- Counting local gates multiplies positions, fixed machine cases, coordinates,
and the constant per-gate cost; no row truth table appears. -/
private theorem codecTransitionCNF_cost (M : FinTM Bool) (n s : ℕ) :
    codecCnfCost (codecTransitionCNF M n s) ≤
      Fintype.card (CodecPositions M n s) * Fintype.card (CodecCase M) *
      Fintype.card (CodecBit M n s) * (2 ^ (3 * M.k + 7) * (3 * M.k + 8)) := by
  have h := codecCnfCost_flatMap_le (Finset.univ.toList : List (CodecGateIndex M n s))
    (fun ix => codecGateCNF M n s ix.1 ix.2.1 ix.2.2)
    (2 ^ (3 * M.k + 7) * (3 * M.k + 8)) (fun ix _ => (codecGateCNF_spec M n s _ _ _).1)
  simpa only [codecTransitionCNF, Finset.length_toList, Finset.card_univ,
    CodecGateIndex, Fintype.card_prod, Nat.mul_assoc] using h

/-- The numbered adjacency formula includes the separate carried-input equality conjunct. -/
private noncomputable def configurationAdjacency (M : FinTM Bool) (C n s : ℕ) : CNF ℕ :=
  (codecInputEquality M n s ++ codecTransitionCNF M n s).relabel (codecPairWire M C n s)

/-- The numbered adjacency formula has the required quotient-step interpretation. -/
private theorem configurationAdjacency_eval (M : FinTM Bool) (C n s : ℕ)
    (hC : codecCoefficient M ≤ C) (x : List Bool) (hx : x.length = n)
    (c d : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (hc : c.InWindow s) (hd : d.InWindow s) :
    (configurationAdjacency M C n s).eval
      (fun v => (configurationCodec M C n s x c ++ configurationCodec M C n s x d).getD v false)
      = true ↔ NDTM.coreSum (M.tm.step c) = NDTM.coreSum d := by
  simp only [configurationAdjacency, CNF.eval_relabel, Function.comp_def,
    configurationCodec_pair_get M C n s hC x x hx hx c d, CNF.eval_append,
    Bool.and_eq_true, codecInputEquality_eval, codecTransitionCNF_step_iff M n s x hx c d hc hd]
  exact and_iff_right rfl

/-- Different carried inputs fail the adjacency formula's equality conjunct. -/
private theorem configurationAdjacency_reject (M : FinTM Bool) (C n s : ℕ)
    (hC : codecCoefficient M ≤ C) (x y : List Bool) (hx : x.length = n) (hy : y.length = n)
    (hxy : x ≠ y) (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (d : Cfg M.k Bool M.State y) :
    (configurationAdjacency M C n s).eval
      (fun v => (configurationCodec M C n s x c ++ configurationCodec M C n s y d).getD v false)
      = false := by
  rw [configurationAdjacency, CNF.relabel_append, CNF.eval_append]
  change ((configurationInputEquality M C n s).eval _ && _) = false
  rw [configurationInputEquality_reject M C n s hC x y hx hy hxy c d]
  rfl

/-- Machine-only coefficient for the joint transition enumeration. -/
private def codecTransitionCoefficient (M : FinTM Bool) : ℕ :=
  2 ^ M.k * Fintype.card (CodecCase M) * (2 ^ (3 * M.k + 7) * (3 * M.k + 8))

/-- The transition gates have polynomial cost, of degree `k+2` before serialization. -/
private theorem codecTransitionCNF_cost_poly (M : FinTM Bool) (C n s : ℕ)
    (hC : codecCoefficient M ≤ C) :
    codecCnfCost (codecTransitionCNF M n s) ≤
      codecTransitionCoefficient M * C * (s + n + 2) ^ (M.k + 2) := by
  have hp := codecPositions_card_le M n s
  have hb : Fintype.card (CodecBit M n s) ≤ C * (s + n + 2) :=
    (codecBit_card_le M n s C hC).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega))
  calc
    _ ≤ Fintype.card (CodecPositions M n s) * Fintype.card (CodecCase M) *
        Fintype.card (CodecBit M n s) * (2 ^ (3 * M.k + 7) * (3 * M.k + 8)) :=
      codecTransitionCNF_cost M n s
    _ ≤ (2 ^ M.k * (s + n + 2) ^ (M.k + 1)) * Fintype.card (CodecCase M) *
        (C * (s + n + 2)) * (2 ^ (3 * M.k + 7) * (3 * M.k + 8)) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hp) hb)
    _ = _ := by unfold codecTransitionCoefficient; rw [pow_succ]; ring

/-- Input equality and transition gates share the degree-`k+2` cost ledger. -/
private theorem codecAdjacency_cost (M : FinTM Bool) (C n s : ℕ)
    (hC : codecCoefficient M ≤ C) :
    codecCnfCost (codecInputEquality M n s ++ codecTransitionCNF M n s) ≤
      (6 + codecTransitionCoefficient M) * C * (s + n + 2) ^ (M.k + 2) := by
  have hpos : 1 ≤ C := by unfold codecCoefficient at hC; omega
  have hn : n ≤ C * (s + n + 2) ^ (M.k + 2) := by
    calc
      n ≤ s + n + 2 := by omega
      _ ≤ (s + n + 2) ^ (M.k + 2) := Nat.le_pow (by omega)
      _ ≤ C * (s + n + 2) ^ (M.k + 2) := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by omega)
  rw [codecCnfCost_append]
  calc
    _ ≤ 6 * n + codecTransitionCoefficient M * C * (s + n + 2) ^ (M.k + 2) :=
      Nat.add_le_add (codecInputEquality_cost M n s) (codecTransitionCNF_cost_poly M C n s hC)
    _ ≤ 6 * (C * (s + n + 2) ^ (M.k + 2)) +
        codecTransitionCoefficient M * C * (s + n + 2) ^ (M.k + 2) :=
      Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 6 hn) _
    _ = _ := by ring

/-- Adjacency uses only the two code blocks and has a polynomial serialized length.

**Proof sketch.** Every variable is wired into one of the two padded blocks.
The cost ledger counts both literal occurrences and clause delimiters, including
empty clauses. The public serialization grammar adds one factor bounded by
`5 C (s+n+2)`, hence degree `k+3`; the final terminator is included explicitly. -/
private theorem configurationAdjacency_bounds (M : FinTM Bool) (C n s : ℕ)
    (hC : codecCoefficient M ≤ C) :
    (configurationAdjacency M C n s).numVars ≤ 2 * (C * (s + n + 1)) ∧
    (CNF.serialize (configurationAdjacency M C n s)).length ≤
      (5 * (6 + codecTransitionCoefficient M) + 1) * C ^ 2 * (s + n + 2) ^ (M.k + 3) := by
  have hb : ∀ cl ∈ codecInputEquality M n s ++ codecTransitionCNF M n s,
      ∀ l ∈ cl, codecPairWire M C n s l.1 < 2 * (C * (s + n + 1)) :=
    fun _ _ l _ => codecPairWire_lt M C n s hC l.1
  refine ⟨codecCnf_numVars _ _ _ hb, ?_⟩
  have hpos : 1 ≤ C := by unfold codecCoefficient at hC; omega
  have hindex : 2 * (C * (s + n + 1)) + 3 ≤ 5 * C * (s + n + 2) := by nlinarith
  have hterm : 1 ≤ C ^ 2 * (s + n + 2) ^ (M.k + 3) := by
    exact Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt (by positivity))
  calc
    _ ≤ codecCnfCost (codecInputEquality M n s ++ codecTransitionCNF M n s) *
        (2 * (C * (s + n + 1)) + 3) + 1 := codecCnf_serialize _ _ _ hb
    _ ≤ ((6 + codecTransitionCoefficient M) * C * (s + n + 2) ^ (M.k + 2)) *
        (5 * C * (s + n + 2)) + 1 :=
      Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.mul_le_mul (codecAdjacency_cost M C n s hC) hindex) 1
    _ = 5 * (6 + codecTransitionCoefficient M) * C ^ 2 *
        (s + n + 2) ^ (M.k + 3) + 1 := by rw [pow_succ]; ring
    _ ≤ 5 * (6 + codecTransitionCoefficient M) * C ^ 2 *
        (s + n + 2) ^ (M.k + 3) + C ^ 2 * (s + n + 2) ^ (M.k + 3) :=
      Nat.add_le_add_left hterm _
    _ = _ := by ring


/-- **Claim 4.4(2), packaged quotient form** (proved — phase
P4.3 round 2; used by no proof; see the module docstring's declared deviations): for every
machine there is a constant `C` such that for all `(n, s)` there are a
configuration bit-codec — fixed length `C · (s + n + 1)`, **factoring through the input and the
vertex quotient** `Turing.NDTM.coreSum` on windowed configurations (an iff:
equal codes exactly when equal vertices, at one input) — and three CNFs: `φv` characterizing exactly the codec image
among the length-matching strings, `φa` deciding adjacency (the step, read on
the vertex quotient) on same-input windowed pairs and rejecting cross-input
pairs, and `φacc` deciding acceptance (halted state, `accept` summary); all
three with `numVars` inside the code width and serialized lengths bounded by
`C · (s + n + 2) ^ C` — base `s + n + 2`, not the code width's `s + n + 1`:
at `n = s = 0` the code width equals `C` while one literal reading the
second block already serializes to `C + 6` (round-2 blocker, finding 1).

**Proof sketch.** The codec is the marker discipline of the Cook-Levin
tableau row (`TCSlib.Complexity.CookLevin` precedents), now carrying the
input: an input-content track of `n` bits, a one-hot input-position track of
length `n + 2`, a one-hot state block (halt included), per work tape a window
track of `2s + 1` cells — three-valued symbol plus a head-marker bit — and a
two-bit summary block; total length linear in `s + n` with the machine's
constants in `C`, padded to the exact `C · (s + n + 1)`. Injectivity to
`(x, coreSum)` mirrors `Turing.MultiTapeTM.ConfigCount.coreCode_inj` on the
window tracks plus the content track; the output enters only through the
summary block (full-output injectivity is impossible and not claimed —
round-1 finding 1). `φv` conjoins per-track well-formedness (one-hot blocks,
trit ranges, canonical padding); `φacc` reads the halt pattern and the
summary block; `φa` conjoins content-track equality, locality of unmarked
window cells, the marked-cell and neighbor updates by the transition table —
the scanned input bit read from the content track under the position
marker — the one-hot shifts by at most one, the state rewrite, and the
summary update (`Turing.outSummary`'s append table): the one-hot blocks' uniqueness
constraints are pairwise-exclusion clauses — quadratic in the block length,
polynomial overall — and the transition checks are enumerated over the
input-position and work-head tuples jointly with the finitely many
state/scanned-symbol cases (the head markers couple the tracks:
`(n + 2) · (2s + 1)^k` guarded cases for the fixed machine), each case a
constant-size CNF by the chapter-2 universality
(`Complexity.exists_cnf_boolFun`, applied per **gate**, never per row — a
whole-row truth table is exponential); the honest count is polynomial, not
linear (round-2 finding 4), bounding clause count, `numVars`, and the
serialized lengths (the chapter-2 grammar's serialization-length equation —
clause count enters it explicitly, round-1 finding 8). Fill obligations,
named: the codec definition with exact-length padding; the two injectivity
lemmas; the validity characterization in both directions; the per-position
check enumeration; the three serialized-size ledgers; the
step-iff-adjacency equivalence through `Turing.NDTM.coreSum_stepWith`. -/
theorem exists_adjacency_codec_cnf (M : Turing.FinTM Bool) :
    ∃ C : ℕ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (n s : ℕ),
      ∃ (code : (x : List Bool) → Cfg M.k Bool M.State x → List Bool)
        (φv φa φacc : CNF ℕ),
        (∀ (x : List Bool) (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x),
          (code x c).length = C * (s + n + 1)) ∧
        (∀ (x x' : List Bool), x.length = n → x'.length = n →
          ∀ (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (c' : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x'),
            c.InWindow s → c'.InWindow s → code x c = code x' c' → x = x') ∧
        (∀ (x : List Bool), x.length = n →
          ∀ c d : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x, c.InWindow s → d.InWindow s →
            (code x c = code x d ↔ NDTM.coreSum c = NDTM.coreSum d)) ∧
        (∀ w : List Bool, w.length = C * (s + n + 1) →
          (φv.eval (fun v => w.getD v false) = true ↔
            ∃ (x : List Bool), x.length = n ∧
              ∃ c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x, c.InWindow s ∧ w = code x c)) ∧
        (∀ (x : List Bool), x.length = n →
          ∀ c d : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x, c.InWindow s → d.InWindow s →
            (φa.eval (fun v => (code x c ++ code x d).getD v false) = true ↔
              NDTM.coreSum (M.tm.step c) = NDTM.coreSum d)) ∧
        (∀ (x x' : List Bool), x.length = n → x'.length = n → x ≠ x' →
          ∀ (c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x) (c' : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x'),
            c.InWindow s → c'.InWindow s →
            φa.eval (fun v => (code x c ++ code x' c').getD v false) = false) ∧
        (∀ (x : List Bool), x.length = n →
          ∀ c : Cfg M.k Bool M.State x, c.InWindow s →
            (φacc.eval (fun v => (code x c).getD v false) = true ↔
              (c.state = none ∧ outSummary c.output = OutSummary.accept))) ∧
        φv.numVars ≤ C * (s + n + 1) ∧
        φacc.numVars ≤ C * (s + n + 1) ∧
        φa.numVars ≤ 2 * (C * (s + n + 1)) ∧
        (CNF.serialize φv).length ≤ C * (s + n + 2) ^ C ∧
        (CNF.serialize φa).length ≤ C * (s + n + 2) ^ C ∧
        (CNF.serialize φacc).length ≤ C * (s + n + 2) ^ C := by
  let B := (3 * codecValidityCoefficient M + 7) +
    (5 * (6 + codecTransitionCoefficient M) + 1) + 13
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hwidth, hsize⟩ := codec_absorb B (M.k + 3) (codecCoefficient M)
  refine ⟨C, hC, fun n s => ?_⟩
  have hp : (s + n + 2) ^ 3 ≤ (s + n + 2) ^ (M.k + 3) := by
    rw [pow_add]
    exact Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left _ (by positivity)
  have hledger (a e : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ B)
      (he : (s + n + 2) ^ e ≤ (s + n + 2) ^ (M.k + 3)) :
      a * C ^ 2 * (s + n + 2) ^ e ≤ C * (s + n + 2) ^ C :=
    (Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ ha) he).trans (hsize _ (by omega))
  refine ⟨configurationCodec M C n s, configurationValidity M C n s,
    configurationAdjacency M C n s, configurationAcceptance M n s,
    configurationCodec_length M C n s, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x y hx hy c d _ _ he
    exact configurationCodec_input_eq M C n s hwidth x y hx hy c d he
  · intro x hx c d hc hd
    exact configurationCodec_eq_iff M C n s hwidth x hx c d hc hd
  · exact configurationValidity_eval M C n s hwidth
  · intro x hx c d hc hd
    exact configurationAdjacency_eval M C n s hwidth x hx c d hc hd
  · intro x y hx hy hxy c d _ _
    exact configurationAdjacency_reject M C n s hwidth x y hx hy hxy c d
  · intro x hx c _
    exact configurationAcceptance_eval M C n s hwidth x hx c
  · exact configurationValidity_numVars M C n s hwidth
  · exact (configurationAcceptance_bounds M C n s hwidth).1
  · exact (configurationAdjacency_bounds M C n s hwidth).1
  · exact (configurationValidity_size M C n s hwidth).trans
      (hledger _ 3 (by dsimp [B]; omega) hp)
  · exact (configurationAdjacency_bounds M C n s hwidth).2.trans
      (hledger _ (M.k + 3) (by dsimp [B]; omega) (Nat.le_refl _))
  · exact (configurationAcceptance_size M C n s hwidth).trans
      (hledger 13 3 (by dsimp [B]; omega) hp)

/-- **The language `TQBF`** [AB09, §4.2]: binary strings whose decoded
quantified formula is true. The decoding fallback is the true closed formula,
so non-well-formed strings are members — the `SAT`-polarity convention of
`Complexity.QBF.decode`. -/
def TQBF : Language Bool :=
  {x | (QBF.decode x).truth}

/-- **`TQBF ∈ PSPACE`** ([AB09, Theorem 4.13, membership half]): truth of a quantified
formula is decidable in polynomial space.

**Proof sketch.** `Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.truth_mem_PSPACE`: a register machine whose
register values stay at most `2 ^ (|x| + 1)`, reading its input through the logspace input-bit and
input-length deciders, concluded by `Complexity.LogProg.arm_decides_pspace_val`. It first
validates the **entire** encoding with a finite automaton (the aligned-pair stage followed by
the grammar automaton `Std.Sat.CNF.syntaxStep`): a rejected string decodes to a fallback with
the empty, true matrix, and is accepted. On a valid encoding `pairEncode qs (serialize φ)` it
runs the recursive evaluator of [AB09] depth first, the partial assignment kept as a binary
stack (a leading `1` and one bit per bound variable): a node at depth `K` reads the pair at
input position `2K` — a doubled quantifier bit or the separator; an inner node evaluates its
first child (push `0`) and, unless that value decides the quantifier, its second (push `1`);
a leaf streams the CNF serialization from position `2K + 2`, looking each literal's variable
up as a bit of the stack. Correctness is by induction on the remaining depth
(`Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.call_spec`) against the stack semantics
`Complexity.LogProg.TQBFARM.Val`, which follows `Complexity.QBF.truthAux`. -/
theorem TQBF_mem_PSPACE : TQBF ∈ PSPACE :=
  LogProg.TQBFARM.truth_mem_PSPACE

/-- **`TQBF` is `PSPACE`-hard** ([AB09, Theorem 4.13, hardness half]): every `PSPACE`
language Karp-reduces in polynomial time to `TQBF`.

**Proof sketch** (`Complexity.TQBFHard.PSPACE_polyTimeReducible_TQBF`, files
`ClassPSPACE/TQBFHard*.lean`). Let `L ∈ PSPACE`, so some nondeterministic `N` decides it in
space `d (n^c + 1)` (`Complexity.PSPACE_subset_NPSPACE`). On `x` the reduction outputs the
encoding of a closed formula over blocks of `w = A (n + 1)^(c + 1)` variables: an existential
top record (a pad, a source block `A`, a target block `B`) followed by `w` levels
`∃ Z ∀ U ∀ V` — [AB09]'s recursion `ψᵢ₊₁(A, B) = ∃ Z ∀ U V (((U, V) = (A, Z) ∨ (U, V) =
(Z, B)) → ψᵢ(U, V))` in prenex form, whose truth is a path of `2^w` steps of the one-step
relation of blocks (`Complexity.TQBFHard.prefixTruth_top`, `mid_iff_steps`). Blocks carry code
words of the configuration codec `Complexity.Codec`; one step is "equal blocks, or a step pair
of codes", and `x ∈ L` iff an initial block reaches an accepting block in `2^w` steps
(`Complexity.TQBFHard.mem_iff_mid`; the width holds a code word and `2^w` bounds the vertex
count). The matrix — initial and accepting tests and the flat selection chain — is a
polynomial-time predicate of `⟨x, σ⟩` (`Complexity.TQBFHard.polyTimeComputable_predB`, the
code languages being in `L ⊆ P`), written as the P-uniform configuration tableau of a machine
computing it (`Complexity.cfgTab`, `⟨x, ⟩` hard-wired) and made a CNF by Tseitin's
transformation with the gate variables quantified existentially after the prefix
(`Complexity.QBF.truth_exSuffix_of_pointwise`, `Complexity.TQBFHard.toCNF_extension_iff`).
The map is polynomial-time as a composition of the tableau emitter
(`Complexity.UTab.polyTimeComputable_tabEmit`, [AB09, Remark 6.7]), the CKT-SAT-to-SAT map
(`BoolCircuit.polyTimeComputable_dagCktSatToSAT3`, [AB09, Lemma 6.11]) and the prefix bits.
It uses no configuration-specific CNFs: the matrix is one polynomial-time predicate. -/
theorem TQBF_PSPACEHard : PSPACEHard TQBF :=
  fun _ hL => TQBFHard.PSPACE_polyTimeReducible_TQBF hL

/-- **The Stockmeyer-Meyer theorem**: `TQBF` is `PSPACE`-complete.
[AB09, Theorem 4.13]

**Proof sketch.** `Complexity.TQBF_mem_PSPACE` with
`Complexity.TQBF_PSPACEHard`. -/
theorem TQBF_PSPACEComplete : PSPACEComplete TQBF :=
  ⟨TQBF_mem_PSPACE, TQBF_PSPACEHard⟩

end Complexity
```

```
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassPSPACE.TQBF
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassPSPACE.Games
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassPSPACE.TQBFARM.Semantics
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassPSPACE.TQBFARM.Machine
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassPSPACE.TQBFARM.Leaf

import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassPSPACE.TQBFHardTseitin
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassPSPACE.TQBFHardVerifier
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassPSPACE.TQBFHardBridge
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassPSPACE.TQBFHardParams
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassPSPACE.TQBFHard

/-!
# `PSPACE`-completeness

[AB09, §4.2]: `PSPACE`-hardness and -completeness, the `TQBF` language and
the Stockmeyer-Meyer theorem, and the game-playing face of the class. The
headline statements (phase P4.3 of `AroraBarakChapters3-4Plan.md`) are
`Complexity.TQBF_PSPACEComplete` ([AB09, Theorem 4.13]) with its two halves,
Claim 4.4(2) in packaged form, and Zermelo determinacy for finite
perfect-information games ([AB09, Exercise 4.10]).

## Contents

- `ClassPSPACE.TQBF`: Definition 4.9, the collapse corollary, Claim 4.4(2)
  in packaged quotient form (`Complexity.exists_adjacency_codec_cnf`), `TQBF`, and
  Theorem 4.13
- `ClassPSPACE.Games`: finite two-person perfect-information games and
  Zermelo determinacy
- `ClassPSPACE.TQBFARM.Semantics`: the pure side of the polynomial-width register machine
  deciding `TQBF`: the syntax automaton of the encodings and the stack semantics `Val`
- `ClassPSPACE.TQBFARM.Machine`: the register machine itself, its register file and its
  loop sites
- `ClassPSPACE.TQBFARM.Leaf`: the machine's evaluation of the CNF matrix at a leaf
- `ClassPSPACE.TQBFARM.Walk`: the syntax check and the depth-first assignment walk; the walk
  is correct at a leaf
- `ClassPSPACE.TQBFARM.Correct`: the walk is correct at every depth; the true quantified
  formulas are in `PSPACE`, behind `Complexity.TQBF_mem_PSPACE`
- `ClassPSPACE.TQBFHardSemantics`: the `ψᵢ` prefix of the hardness reduction: blocks of
  quantifiers and the midpoint recursion `Mid`
- `ClassPSPACE.TQBFHardMachine`: acceptance as a path of blocks carrying code words
- `ClassPSPACE.TQBFHardTseitin`: Tseitin's transformation after the prefix, for circuits
- `ClassPSPACE.TQBFHardVerifier`: the polynomial-time verifier `predB` of the matrix
- `ClassPSPACE.TQBFHardBridge`: the verifier on an assignment is the flat matrix
- `ClassPSPACE.TQBFHardParams`: the block width and the bits of the quantifier prefix
- `ClassPSPACE.TQBFHard`: the reduction of every `PSPACE` language to the true quantified
  formulas, behind `Complexity.TQBF_PSPACEHard`

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.2.)
-/
```

```
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassPSPACE.TQBFHardParams
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassPSPACE.TQBFHardTseitin
import TCSlib.Complexity.CircuitComplexity.UniformTableau
import TCSlib.Complexity.CircuitComplexity.CircuitSatReduction
import TCSlib.Complexity.SpaceComplexity.SpaceClasses
import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassNP.Reductions

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# `TQBF` is `PSPACE`-hard

[AB09, Theorem 4.13, hardness half]: every language in `PSPACE` reduces in polynomial time to
the true quantified Boolean formulas. Let `N` decide `L` in nondeterministic space
`d (n^c + 1)` (`Complexity.PSPACE_subset_NPSPACE`). On input `x` of length `n` the reduction
outputs the encoding of a closed formula

`∃ Z₀ A B ∃ Z_w ∀ U_w ∀ V_w ⋯ ∃ Z₁ ∀ U₁ ∀ V₁ ∃ (auxiliary) · matrix`

over blocks of `w = wCoef N d · (n + 1)^(c + 1)` variables, `w` levels deep:

* **the `ψᵢ` recursion** ([AB09]'s `∀`-folding, `TQBFHardSemantics`): truth of the prefix of
  the levels is the midpoint recursion over the one-step relation of blocks, i.e. a path of
  `2^w` steps (`Complexity.TQBFHard.prefixTruth_top`, `Complexity.TQBFHard.mid_iff_steps`);
* **the configuration graph** (`TQBFHardMachine`): blocks carry code words of the
  configuration codec `Complexity.Codec`, and an initial block reaches an accepting block in
  `2^w` steps iff `x ∈ L` (`Complexity.TQBFHard.mem_iff_mid`; `2^w` bounds the vertex count,
  `Complexity.TQBFHard.configBound_le_two_pow`);
* **the matrix** is the predicate "the block at `w` is initial, the block at `2w` is
  accepting, and the selection chain of the levels ends in a step", computed by the
  polynomial-time verifier `Complexity.TQBFHard.predB` (`TQBFHardVerifier`,
  `TQBFHardBridge`), written as a circuit — the uniform configuration tableau
  `Complexity.cfgTab` of a machine computing the verifier, with `⟨x, ·⟩` hard-wired — and
  turned into a CNF by Tseitin's transformation `BoolCircuit.DAGCircuit.toCNF`, whose gate
  variables are quantified existentially after the whole prefix
  (`Complexity.QBF.truth_exSuffix_of_pointwise` with `Complexity.TQBFHard.toCNF_extension_iff`).

**Polynomial time.** The reduction is a composition of polynomial-time maps: the unary input
`1^{3w(w+1)} 0 1^T 0 ⟨x, ⟩` of the tableau emitter (`Complexity.polyTimeComputable_tabInput`),
the emitter itself (`Complexity.UTab.polyTimeComputable_tabEmit`, [AB09, Remark 6.7]), the
CKT-SAT-to-SAT map (`BoolCircuit.polyTimeComputable_dagCktSatToSAT3`, [AB09, Lemma 6.11]),
and the prefix bits (`Complexity.TQBFHard.polyTimeComputable_levelBits`).

**Deviation from the book's route.** [AB09] writes `ψ₀` as a CNF for the adjacency of two
configurations (Claim 4.4(2)) and leaves the reduction's running time to the reader. Here the
matrix of the whole prenex formula is one polynomial-time predicate, made a CNF by the
P-uniform tableau and Tseitin, so that no configuration-specific CNF (and no emitter for one)
is needed. The midpoints quantify over all blocks without a validity guard: the one-step
relation of blocks is "equal, or a step pair of codes", and a step pair's target is always a
code word, so junk midpoints only occur on trivial (equality) paths.

## Main definitions

* `Complexity.TQBFHard.redQuants`, `Complexity.TQBFHard.redCircuit`,
  `Complexity.TQBFHard.redQBF`, `Complexity.TQBFHard.redMap` — the reduction.

## Main results

* `Complexity.TQBFHard.truth_redQBF` — the formula is true iff `x ∈ L`.
* `Complexity.TQBFHard.polyTimeComputable_redMap` — the reduction is polynomial-time.
* `Complexity.TQBFHard.PSPACE_polyTimeReducible_TQBF` — `L ∈ PSPACE` reduces to the true
  quantified Boolean formulas. [AB09, Theorem 4.13, hardness half]

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§4.2, Theorem 4.13 and its proof; §6.1, Remark 6.7 and
  Lemma 6.11.)
* [SM73] L. Stockmeyer, A. Meyer, *Word problems requiring exponential time*, STOC 1973.
  (Cited through [AB09].)
-/

namespace Complexity

namespace TQBFHard

open Turing BoolCircuit Codec QBF Std.Sat

/-- **The CKT-SAT reduction map on a description** of a fan-in-two circuit is the
serialization of its Tseitin formula. -/
theorem dagCktSatToSAT3_encode {n : ℕ} (C : DAGCircuit n) (hC : C.IsFaninTwo) :
    dagCktSatToSAT3 C.encode = CNF.serialize C.toCNF := by
  simp [dagCktSatToSAT3, dagCktSatToCNF, DAGCircuit.decode_encode, hC]

variable (N : FinNDTM Bool) (d c : ℕ) (V : FinTM Bool) (CV cV : ℕ)

/-- The block width `w = wCoef N d · (n + 1)^(c + 1)`. -/
def redW (n : ℕ) : ℕ := vwid (wCoef N d) (c + 1) n

/-- The number `3w(w + 1)` of prefix variables. -/
def redM (n : ℕ) : ℕ := 3 * redW N d c n * redW N d c n + 3 * redW N d c n

/-- The constant bounding `|⟨x, σ⟩| + 1` by `K (n + 1)^(2(c + 1))`. -/
def redK : ℕ := 3 * wCoef N d * wCoef N d + 3 * wCoef N d + 3

/-- The tableau's time bound: at least the verifier's running time on `⟨x, σ⟩`, and `≥ 1`. -/
def redT (n : ℕ) : ℕ := CV * redK N d ^ cV * (n + 1) ^ (2 * (c + 1) * cV) + 1

/-- **The matrix circuit**: the uniform tableau of the verifier machine `V` for
`redT n` steps, on `3w(w + 1)` free inputs (the prefix variables) after the hard-wired word
`⟨x, ` (`pairEncode x []`). -/
noncomputable def redCircuit (x : List Bool) : DAGCircuit (redM N d c x.length) :=
  cfgTab V (redM N d c x.length) (pairEncode x []) (redT N d c CV cV x.length)

/-- **The quantifier prefix**: three existential blocks (the pad `Z₀`, the source `A`, the
target `B`), then `w` levels `∃^w ∀^w ∀^w`. -/
def redQuants (n : ℕ) : List Quant :=
  List.replicate (redW N d c n) .ex ++ (List.replicate (redW N d c n) .ex ++
    (List.replicate (redW N d c n) .ex ++ levelQuants (redW N d c n) (redW N d c n)))

/-- **The quantified formula**: the prefix, then one existential per letter of the
serialized matrix (enough for every Tseitin variable), and the Tseitin formula of the matrix
circuit. -/
noncomputable def redQBF (x : List Bool) : QBF :=
  ⟨redQuants N d c x.length ++
      List.replicate (CNF.serialize (redCircuit N d c V CV cV x).toCNF).length .ex,
    (redCircuit N d c V CV cV x).toCNF⟩

/-- **The reduction map**: the encoding of `redQBF x`. -/
noncomputable def redMap (x : List Bool) : List Bool := QBF.encode (redQBF N d c V CV cV x)

/-- The prefix has `3w(w + 1)` variables. -/
theorem length_redQuants (n : ℕ) : (redQuants N d c n).length = redM N d c n := by
  simp only [redQuants, List.length_append, List.length_replicate, length_levelQuants, redM]
  ring

/-- **The verifier runs within the tableau's time bound** on `⟨x, σ⟩`, `|σ| = 3w(w + 1)`.

**Proof sketch.** With `P = (n + 1) ^ (c + 1)` and `A = wCoef N d`, the input length is
`|⟨x, σ⟩| + 1 = 2n + 3 + 3A²P² + 3AP ≤ redK · P² = redK · (n + 1) ^ (2(c + 1))` (using
`n + 1 ≤ P ≤ P²`); raising to `cV` and multiplying by `CV` gives
`CV · redK ^ cV · (n + 1) ^ (2(c + 1) cV) ≤ redT`. -/
theorem time_le (x σ : List Bool) (hσ : σ.length = redM N d c x.length) :
    CV * ((pairEncode x σ).length + 1) ^ cV ≤ redT N d c CV cV x.length := by
  set n := x.length
  set A := wCoef N d
  set P := (n + 1) ^ (c + 1)
  have hP1 : 1 ≤ P := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
  have hnP : n + 1 ≤ P := by
    calc n + 1 = (n + 1) ^ 1 := (pow_one _).symm
      _ ≤ P := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
  have hPP : P ≤ P * P := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ hP1
  have hlen : (pairEncode x σ).length + 1 ≤ redK N d * (n + 1) ^ (2 * (c + 1)) := by
    rw [length_pairEncode, hσ]
    have e1 : (n + 1) ^ (2 * (c + 1)) = P * P := by rw [two_mul, pow_add]
    have e2 : redM N d c n = 3 * A * A * (P * P) + 3 * A * P := by
      simp only [redM, redW, vwid, A, P]; ring
    rw [e1, e2]
    have h1 : 3 * A * P ≤ 3 * A * (P * P) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hPP
    have h2 : 2 * n + 3 ≤ 3 * (P * P) := by nlinarith
    have e3 : redK N d * (P * P) = 3 * A * A * (P * P) + 3 * A * (P * P) + 3 * (P * P) := by
      simp only [redK, A]; ring
    rw [e3]
    omega
  calc CV * ((pairEncode x σ).length + 1) ^ cV
      ≤ CV * (redK N d * (n + 1) ^ (2 * (c + 1))) ^ cV :=
        Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Nat.pow_le_pow_left hlen _)
    _ = CV * redK N d ^ cV * (n + 1) ^ (2 * (c + 1) * cV) := by rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul]; ring
    _ ≤ redT N d c CV cV n := Nat.le_succ _

/-- **The matrix circuit computes the verifier** on `⟨x, σ⟩`, `σ` its input assignment.

**Proof sketch.** `Complexity.cfgTab_eval`: the tableau outputs `1` iff `V` emits `1` within
`redT` steps on `⟨x, ⟩ ++ σ = ⟨x, σ⟩`; `V` computes `[predB ⟨x, σ⟩]` within that time
(`time_le`), so this is `predB ⟨x, σ⟩` (`Complexity.decide_emits_eq_of_computesInTime`). -/
theorem eval_redCircuit
    (hV : V.ComputesFunInTime (fun y => [predB N d c (wCoef N d) (c + 1) y])
      (fun m => CV * (m + 1) ^ cV))
    (x : List Bool) (τ : ℕ → Bool) :
    (redCircuit N d c V CV cV x).eval (fun i => τ i) =
      predB N d c (wCoef N d) (c + 1)
        (pairEncode x (List.ofFn fun j : Fin (redM N d c x.length) => τ j)) := by
  set σ := List.ofFn fun j : Fin (redM N d c x.length) => τ j
  have hσ : σ.length = redM N d c x.length := by simp [σ]
  have hz : pairEncode x [] ++ σ = pairEncode x σ := by
    simp [pairEncode, List.append_assoc]
  rw [redCircuit, cfgTab_eval, hz]
  exact decide_emits_eq_of_computesInTime
    ((hV (pairEncode x σ)).mono (time_le N d c CV cV x σ hσ))

variable {N d c}

/-- **The formula is true iff `x ∈ L`** ([AB09, Theorem 4.13, the proof]): for `N` deciding
`L` in space `d (n^c + 1)` and `V` computing the verifier in time `CV (m + 1)^{cV}`.

**Proof sketch.** Tseitin after the prefix (`Complexity.QBF.truth_exSuffix_of_pointwise`,
`toCNF_extension_iff`; the serialization is longer than the number of variables,
`numVars_le_length_serialize`) leaves the prefix truth of "the circuit accepts the prefix
assignment", which is the verifier (`eval_redCircuit`), i.e. the initial and accepting tests
and the flat matrix (`predB_iff`), i.e. the prenex `ψ` matrix (`levelMatrix_iff_flat`). Its
prefix truth is "some initial `A` reaches some accepting `B` in the midpoint recursion of
depth `w`" (`prefixTruth_top`), which is `x ∈ L` (`mem_iff_mid`, with the radius at least the
space bound and the width bounds `vlen_le_vwid`, `configBound_le_two_pow`). -/
theorem truth_redQBF {L : Language Bool} (hN : N.DecidesInSpace L fun n => d * (n ^ c + 1))
    (hV : V.ComputesFunInTime (fun y => [predB N d c (wCoef N d) (c + 1) y])
      (fun m => CV * (m + 1) ^ cV))
    (x : List Bool) : (redQBF N d c V CV cV x).truth ↔ x ∈ L := by
  set n := x.length
  set w := redW N d c n with hw
  set s := vrad d c n
  set Lc := vlen N d c n
  set C := redCircuit N d c V CV cV x
  have hqlen := length_redQuants N d c n
  -- Tseitin after the prefix
  rw [redQBF, truth_exSuffix_of_pointwise (redQuants N d c n) C.toCNF _
    (fun σ => C.eval (fun i => σ i) = true)
    ((numVars_le_length_serialize _).trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _))
    (fun σ => by rw [hqlen]; exact toCNF_extension_iff C (cfgTab_isFaninTwo _ _ _ _).2 σ)]
  -- the circuit is the prenex matrix
  have hleaf : ∀ τ : ℕ → Bool, C.eval (fun i => τ i) = true ↔
      blockInit N x s Lc (readBlock τ w w) ∧ blockAcc N x s Lc (readBlock τ (2 * w) w) ∧
        levelMatrix w (blockStep N x s Lc) w (3 * w) (readBlock τ w w)
          (readBlock τ (2 * w) w) τ := by
    intro τ
    rw [eval_redCircuit N d c V CV cV hV x τ]
    have hflat := levelMatrix_iff_flat w (blockStep N x s Lc) τ w 0
    simp only [Nat.zero_add, Nat.mul_one, uRec, vRec, Nat.mul_zero] at hflat
    rw [hflat]
    exact predB_iff N d c (wCoef N d) (c + 1) x τ (vlen_le_vwid N d c n)
  rw [prefixTruth_congr hleaf]
  rw [redQuants, prefixTruth_top]
  have hs : d * (n ^ c + 1) ≤ s := by
    have h1 : n ^ c ≤ (n + 1) ^ c := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) _
    have h2 : 1 ≤ (n + 1) ^ c := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ (by omega)
    have : d * (n ^ c + 1) ≤ d * (2 * (n + 1) ^ c) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)
    simp only [s, vrad]
    linarith
  exact (mem_iff_mid N hN x s w hs (vlen_le_vwid N d c n) (configBound_le_two_pow N d c n)).symm

variable (N d c)

/-- The unary number of prefix variables is polynomial-time. -/
theorem pt_redM : PolyTimeComputable fun x => List.replicate (redM N d c x.length) true := by
  have h := (polyTimeComputable_polyUnary (3 * wCoef N d * wCoef N d) (2 * (c + 1))).append
    (polyTimeComputable_polyUnary (3 * wCoef N d) (c + 1))
  convert h using 1
  funext x
  rw [← List.replicate_add]
  congr 1
  simp only [redM, redW, vwid, two_mul, pow_add]
  ring

/-- **The reduction is polynomial-time** ([AB09, Theorem 4.13]: "the formula can be computed
in polynomial time").

**Proof sketch.** `redMap x` is the pair of the prefix bits and the serialized Tseitin
formula. The formula is the CKT-SAT map (`BoolCircuit.polyTimeComputable_dagCktSatToSAT3`)
of the tableau emitter's output (`Complexity.UTab.polyTimeComputable_tabEmit`,
`Complexity.UTab.tabEmit_eq`) on the polynomial-time input `1^M 0 1^T 0 ⟨x, ⟩`
(`Complexity.polyTimeComputable_tabInput`); the prefix bits are `1^{3w}`, the level bits
(`polyTimeComputable_levelBits`), and one `1` per letter of the formula. -/
theorem polyTimeComputable_redMap : PolyTimeComputable (redMap N d c V CV cV) := by
  have hT : PolyTimeComputable fun x =>
      List.replicate (redT N d c CV cV x.length) true := by
    have := (polyTimeComputable_polyUnary (CV * redK N d ^ cV) (2 * (c + 1) * cV)).append
      (polyTimeComputable_const [true])
    convert this using 1
    funext x
    simp [redT, List.replicate_add]
  have hinp := polyTimeComputable_tabInput (pt_redM N d c) hT
    (polyTimeComputable_id.pairEncode (polyTimeComputable_const []))
  have hser := polyTimeComputable_dagCktSatToSAT3.comp
    ((UTab.polyTimeComputable_tabEmit V).comp hinp)
  have hser_eq : ∀ x, (dagCktSatToSAT3 ∘ UTab.tabEmit V ∘ fun x =>
      List.replicate (redM N d c x.length) true ++ false ::
        (List.replicate (redT N d c CV cV x.length) true ++ false :: pairEncode (id x) [])) x =
      CNF.serialize (redCircuit N d c V CV cV x).toCNF := by
    intro x
    simp only [Function.comp, id]
    rw [UTab.tabEmit_eq V _ _ _ (by simp [redT]), dagCktSatToSAT3_encode _
      (cfgTab_isFaninTwo _ _ _ _)]
    rfl
  have h3w : PolyTimeComputable fun x =>
      List.replicate (3 * redW N d c x.length) true := by
    have := polyTimeComputable_polyUnary (3 * wCoef N d) (c + 1)
    convert this using 1
    funext x
    simp only [redW, vwid]
    ring_nf
  have hlev := polyTimeComputable_levelBits (w := fun x => redW N d c x.length)
    (polyTimeComputable_polyUnary (wCoef N d) (c + 1))
  have hall := ((h3w.append hlev).append (polyTimeComputable_unary.comp hser)).pairEncode hser
  convert hall using 1
  funext x
  have hs : dagCktSatToSAT3 (UTab.tabEmit V (List.replicate (redM N d c x.length) true ++
      false :: (List.replicate (redT N d c CV cV x.length) true ++ false :: pairEncode x []))) =
      CNF.serialize (redCircuit N d c V CV cV x).toCNF := by
    simpa using hser_eq x
  simp only [Function.comp, id, hs]
  simp only [redMap, QBF.encode, redQBF, redQuants, List.map_append, List.map_replicate,
    map_quantBit_levelQuants, quantBit]
  congr 1
  rw [show 3 * redW N d c x.length =
      redW N d c x.length + redW N d c x.length + redW N d c x.length by ring,
    List.replicate_add, List.replicate_add]
  simp only [List.append_assoc]

/-- **`PSPACE` reduces to `TQBF`** ([AB09, Theorem 4.13, hardness half]): every language in
`PSPACE` Karp-reduces in polynomial time to the set of strings whose decoded quantified
Boolean formula is true.

**Proof sketch.** `L ∈ NPSPACE` (`Complexity.PSPACE_subset_NPSPACE`): some `N` decides `L` in
space `d (n^c + 1)`. The verifier of the reduction is polynomial-time
(`polyTimeComputable_predB`); take a machine `V` computing it. The map `redMap` is
polynomial-time (`polyTimeComputable_redMap`) and decodes to `redQBF x`
(`Complexity.QBF.decode_encode`), which is true iff `x ∈ L` (`truth_redQBF`). -/
theorem PSPACE_polyTimeReducible_TQBF {L : Language Bool} (hL : L ∈ PSPACE) :
    L ≤ₚ {x | (QBF.decode x).truth} := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp (PSPACE_subset_NPSPACE hL)
  obtain ⟨d, N, hN⟩ := hc
  obtain ⟨V, CV, cV, hV⟩ := polyTimeComputable_predB N d c (wCoef N d) (c + 1)
  refine ⟨redMap N d c V CV cV, polyTimeComputable_redMap N d c V CV cV, fun x => ?_⟩
  show x ∈ L ↔ (QBF.decode (QBF.encode (redQBF N d c V CV cV x))).truth
  rw [QBF.decode_encode]
  exact (truth_redQBF V CV cV hN hV x).symm

end TQBFHard

end Complexity
```
